The eye is a bloodshot eyeball torn from its socket, the hand a mummified left hand. Eye: gouge out your own, push the artifact into the socket, and it fuses until you die, turns golden with a slit pupil, and kills you if removed. Hand: sever yours at the wrist and press it to the stump.
Guild Keyrune|GGR: A stone key carved in ceremonial style for one guild, roughly a foot in length. It isn't a working key but a mark of authority, giving the bearer entry to restricted areas in the headquarters and outposts of that guild. A DM can hand one to a character who reaches renown score 25 there.
Imbued Wood Focus|ERLW: Spellcasters can use this item as a spellcasting focus. It comes from a tree full of extraplanar energy, in wand, rod, or staff form. Cast a damage spell through it and add +1 to one damage roll if the damage matches the wood's type. Fernian Ash is fire, Irian Rosewood radiant, Kythrian Manchineel poison or acid, Lamannian Oak thunder or lightning, Mabaran Ebony necrotic, Risian Pine cold, Shavarran Birch force, and Xorian Wenge psychic.
Lantern of Tracking|IDROTF: A hooded lantern that burns for 6 hours per pint of oil, giving bright light to 30 feet and dim light for 30 feet beyond. Rolls 1 to 10 give Aberrations, Celestials, Constructs, Dragons, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, Giants, Monstrosities, and Undead in order. The flame turns bright green when that type is within 300 feet, without showing where.
Mind Crystal|PABTSO: A gem storing a crystallized scrap of spellcasting magic. Each variety has its own one-time effect. Holding one while you cast a spell with a 1 action casting time lets you tweak that spell in a set way. One crystal at most per spell, and not alongside a Metamagic option. After use it becomes a plain gem worth 50 gp.
Rod of the Honed Mind|AU: Sample: a Warlock holds an Uncommon magic item, a +1 pact-keeper rod, gifted by scholars of the Warlock's patron from beyond the stars. Odd symbols mark it and grow more intricate whenever it evolves.
Shard Solitaire|KFTGV: Rift Step (bonus action): teleport with gear to a seen empty space within 30 feet, or 60 on a passed DC 16 Constitution save, else 3d10 force damage. 6 charges, 1d6 regained at dawn. Spells, DC 16: banishment (3, target sent into the gem), mirror image (1). Black sapphire: blight (3), finger of death (6). Diamond: ice storm (3), simulacrum (6). Jacinth: fireball (2), fire storm (6). Rainbow pearl: water breathing (2), prismatic spray (6). Ruby: fly (2), teleport (6).
The Bloody End|EGW: An adamantine morningstar holding Bane's power. It has spikes a foot long and a jagged blade on the pommel.
Wave-Swept Weapon|AU: A weapon decorated with sea themes, including wave etchings along the blade and sea monsters stitched into the leather grip.
+2 Wraps of Unarmed Power|XDMG: Worn, these wraps give you +2 to attack and damage rolls with your Unarmed Strikes. You choose whether each strike deals Force damage or its usual type.
Bringers of Cosmic Dawn Trinket|AU: Roll a d6 for a trinket. 1 is a razor-sharp violet talon. 2 is an uneven spyglass lens throwing a flickering pale-green glow. 3 is a rock engraved with stars from an unfamiliar constellation. 4 is a prophecy about flumphs, torn into fragments. 5 is a fern frond twitching like a tentacle. 6 is a small box with an undying worm inside.
Copper (cp)|PHB: The smallest common coin, mostly used by laborers and beggars. One pays for chalk, a torch, or a candle. Ten copper pieces make one silver piece. Fifty coins make a pound.
Cult of the Dragon Trinket|FRHOF: Roll a d6 for a trinket. 1 is a pendant of a dragon's claw on leather cord. 2 is a small brass canister of dracolich ashes. 3 is a map of the lair of a dragon no one knows. 4 is a black pearl bearing an etched Draconic rune. 5 is amber holding a preserved dragon's blood drop. 6 is a purple silk scrap.
Emerald Enclave Trinket|FRHOF: Roll a d6 for a trinket. 1 is a pair of oak-leaf earrings that never wilt. 2 is a tiny cottage model made of twigs. 3 is a bottled firefly glowing green. 4 is a gourd that rustles like leaves at your ear. 5 is a leather-strapped rabbit's foot, preserved. 6 is an antler in the form of an Elvish rune.
Enspelled Staff (Level 3)|XDMG: When made, this staff has a level 3 spell of any magic school bound into it. It holds 6 charges, and 1d6 return daily at dawn. Holding it, you cast the spell by expending 1 charge. After spending the final charge, roll 1d20, and a 1 turns it into a nonmagical Quarterstaff. Save DC is 15 and attack bonus is 7.
Enspelled Staff (Level 7)|XDMG: When made, this staff has a level 7 spell of any magic school bound into it. It holds 6 charges, and 1d6 return daily at dawn. Gold (gp)|PHB: The standard unit of wealth. One buys a goat, a belt pouch, or fifty feet of sturdy rope, and a decent, non-exceptional artisan earns about one daily. Large deals typically move bars of gold, credit letters, or valuable goods rather than loose coins. Ten silver pieces equal one, and a platinum piece equals ten of it. Fifty coins make a pound.
Iron Pot|PHB: A pot with a capacity of 1 gallon of liquid.
Nib|WDH: A copper coin roughly thumbnail-sized, equal to one ordinary copper coin.
Phantasmic Circus Trinket|AU: Roll a d6 for a trinket. 1 is a poster for an earlier circus show with your face on it. 2 is white greasepaint in a little tin. 3 is a stem of green wire that, flourished with drama, conjures a 1-minute illusory flower. 4 is a delicate silk ribbon, nine feet by two inches. 5 is bronze finger cymbals. 6 is a battered top hat.
Portable Ram|PHB: Use it to batter down doors, adding +4 to your Strength check. Another character can help, which gives you advantage on the check.
Primal Amulet|XMTS: A beaded jade necklace with an ancient River Heralds symbol. Its wearer can cast pass without trace, speak with animals, or locate object. After a spell is cast from it, that spell is locked out until the next dawn.
Red Wizard Trinket|FRHOF: Roll a d6 for a trinket. 1 is a gnarled wand of petrified yew. 2 is a glass jar with an unknown animal's heart inside, preserved. 3 is a unicorn figurine carved in obsidian. 4 is a tattoo needle made of your own bone. 5 is a bronze amulet shaped like a scorpion. 6 is a razor of crimson steel.
Ring of Elemental Command (Fire)|XDMG: Wearing it, you attack Elementals with Advantage and they attack you with Disadvantage. As a Magic action, target an Elemental within 60 feet, which needs a DC 18 Wisdom save or is Charmed until your next turn starts, with you choosing its move and action. You know Ignan and are immune to Fire. 5 charges, 1d4 + 1 back at dawn. Cast Fireball (2 charges), Burning Hands (1), Fire Storm (4), or Wall of Fire (3), save DC 18.
Scroll of Protection (Aberrations)|XDMG: A Scroll of Protection tuned to aberrations. See the general Scroll of Protection entry for how it works.
Scroll of Protection (Dragons)|XDMG: A Scroll of Protection tuned to dragons. See the general Scroll of Protection entry for how it works.
Scroll of Protection (Giants)|XDMG: A Scroll of Protection tuned to giants. See the general Scroll of Protection entry for how it works.
Scroll of Protection (Plants)|XDMG: A Scroll of Protection tuned to plants. See the general Scroll of Protection entry for how it works.
Scroll of Titan Summoning (Colossus)|XDM: Reading this scroll with a Magic action calls forth a Colossus in an open space up to 1 mile away that you see, ground or water. Silver (sp)|PHB: The coin most common among commoners. One silver pays for a day of a laborer's work, lamp oil by the flask, or a stay at a poor inn. Ten silver pieces equal one gold piece, and ten copper pieces equal one silver. Five silver equal one electrum. Fifty coins make a pound.

Wizards can copy it with a DC 13 Intelligence (Arcana) check, destroying the scroll.
Spell Scroll (7th Level)|DMG: Mystical cipher on this scroll encodes one spell, which you cast by reading it with no material components if your class lists it. Taol|WDH: A brass coin roughly two inches on each side, with a hole big enough for a nib. 1 taol equals 200 nib.
Zhentarim Trinket|FRHOF: Roll a d6 for a trinket. 1 is a snapped dagger engraved with your name. 2 is a glass eyeball that keeps turning toward you. 3 is a serpent's tooth the color of gold. 4 is a fake gold coin. 5 is a tattoo needle of crystal. 6 is a contract on parchment that no crease, rip, or flame can harm.
Hooked Shortspear|OOTA: On a hit, the wielder may give up damage to try tripping the target, who must then pass a Strength save to stay up, or be prone. DC: 8 plus Strength modifier plus proficiency bonus, both the wielder's.
Spiked Armor|SCAG: Dwarves craft this rare medium armor. It is a leather coat with matching leggings, covered in spikes that are usually metal.
+1 Shield (*)|DMG: Holding this shield gives you +1 to AC, on top of the shield's regular AC bonus.
+2 Armor|DMG: Wearing this armor gives you +2 to AC.
+3 Ammunition|DMG: This magic ammunition gives you +3 on attack rolls and on damage rolls. It stops being magical after hitting a target.
+3 Weapon (no damage)|DMG: You get +3 on attack rolls with this weapon.
Aquatic Wave-Swept Weapon|AU: A sea-themed weapon. Barnacled: barnacles crust the guard and blade, you get +1 on attack and damage rolls, and a Magic action lets you touch a gallon of liquid at most to add brine, like making fresh water salty. Aquatic: the etchings glow with Bright Light for 5 feet and Dim Light 5 feet beyond. The bonus becomes +2, you breathe underwater, and you swim at 30 feet.
Armor of Force Resistance|DMG: A variant of Armor of Resistance that gives resistance to force damage. See the base Armor of Resistance entry.
Armor of Poison Resistance|DMG: A variant of Armor of Resistance that gives resistance to poison damage. See the base Armor of Resistance entry.
Armor of the Fallen|BMT: While you wear it, the armor can cast Animate Dead or Speak with Dead. After one casting, neither works until the next dawn. It is held together by your soul and is destroyed if you die while attuned.
Ascendant Dragon's Wrath Weapon|FTD: Dragon decor covers it, and it absorbs hoard breath energy. Scoring a natural 20 hits each creature you pick near the target (5 feet or less) for 5 damage of the breath weapon's type. You gain +3 on attack and damage rolls, and hits add 3d6 of that type. As an action, release a 60-foot cone, with a DC 18 Dexterity save for 12d6 of that type, half on a success. Recharges at dawn.
Blade of the Medusa|LLK: On a roll of 20 to hit, the target also makes a DC 15 Constitution save. Failing leaves it restrained, saving again each turn end. Three passed saves end it, three failed ones petrify it for 1 hour. Immune: creatures that shrug off its damage type, aren't made of flesh, or have legendary actions. Curse: attuning shares it, so you keep the weapon until remove curse or similar magic lifts it. Rolling 1 to hit risks the same save.
Bow of Melodies|BMT: Multiple strings make this bow look like a small harp or lyre. Strumming as you nock an arrow infuses it with magic. Choose a melody before a ranged attack roll, and only one per attack. Precision melody: Performance proficiency adds +1 to the attack roll, and Performance expertise adds +2. Reverberation melody: the strum rings out, and a hit adds thunder damage matching your Charisma modifier.
Dazzling Weapon|EFA: Gives +1 on attack and damage rolls. A Bonus Action while holding it makes it shed Bright Light 30 feet and Dim Light 30 feet beyond, and another ends it. It has 4 charges. After an attack roll hits you, a Reaction spends a charge, and the attacker faces a DC 15 Constitution save, gaining Blinded through its next turn's end if it fails. 1d4 charges return at dawn.
Dragon Wing Bow|FTD: This magic bow has wing-shaped limb tips and carries breath essence from a dragon, whether chromatic, gem, or metallic. Hitting with it adds 1d6 damage of the infused type: thunder, radiant, psychic, poison, necrotic, lightning, force, fire, cold, or acid. If you load nothing, drawing back the string conjures a single magic arrow or bolt that vanishes right after hitting or missing.
Drow +1 Weapon|MM: Attack and damage rolls with this weapon get +1. Its enchantment bonus is lost for good if it spends 1 hour or more in sunlight.
Drow +3 Weapon|MM: Attack and damage rolls with this weapon get +3. Its enchantment bonus is lost for good if it spends 1 hour or more in sunlight.
Enspelled Armor (Level 3)|XDMG: At creation, a level 3 spell is bound into this armor, restricted to these schools: Abjuration or Illusion. It holds 6 charges, and 1d6 return daily at dawn. By wearing it, you cast the spell for 1 charge. Save DC is 15 and attack bonus is 7.
Enspelled Armor (Level 7)|XDMG: At creation, a level 7 spell is bound into this armor, restricted to these schools: Abjuration or Illusion. It holds 6 charges, and 1d6 return daily at dawn. By wearing it, you cast the spell for 1 charge. Save DC is 18 and attack bonus is 10.
Enspelled Weapon (Level 2)|XDMG: At creation, a level 2 spell is bound into this weapon. Its school must be one of Necromancy, Transmutation, Conjuration, Divination, or Evocation. It holds 6 charges, and 1d6 return daily at dawn. By holding it, you cast the spell for 1 charge. Save DC is 13 and attack bonus is 5.
Enspelled Weapon (Level 6)|XDMG: At creation, a level 6 spell is bound into this weapon. Its school must be one of Necromancy, Transmutation, Conjuration, Divination, or Evocation. It holds 6 charges, and 1d6 return daily at dawn. By holding it, you cast the spell for 1 charge. Save DC is 17 and attack bonus is 9.
Fool's Blade|BMT: An ordinary-looking, illusion-charged weapon. You get +2 on attack and damage rolls. Fool's Feint: a bonus action to feint at a creature 5 feet or less away, giving you advantage on attacks against it until your next turn starts. Misdirect: when something 60 feet or less away makes an attack roll against you, your reaction forces a DC 15 Intelligence save, and on a failure its attack hits someone else you choose within its reach. Each recharges at dawn.
Gloomwrought Armor|BMT: Gray, intricate armor made in the Shadowfell and infused with its gloom. Wearing it grants advantage on saves against becoming frightened or to shake off that condition. It has 3 charges, and one charge casts Calm Emotions with save DC 15. 1d3 charges return at dawn.
Imbued Wood (Irian Rosewood)|ERLW: It comes from a tree full of extraplanar energy, and spellcasters can wield it as a spellcasting focus. Casting a damage spell through it gives you +1 on a single radiant damage roll.
Imbued Wood (Risian Pine)|ERLW: It comes from a tree full of extraplanar energy, and spellcasters can wield it as a spellcasting focus. Casting a damage spell through it gives you +1 on a single cold damage roll.
Life-Sapping Blade|AUD: A slim black iron blade popular with Thayan spies and assassins. You gain +1 on attack and damage rolls with it. On a hit, the target suffers 2d4 more Necrotic damage and gets no Hit Point recovery through its next turn. A creature this blade drops to 0 Hit Points dies on the spot, and only Resurrection or True Resurrection can bring it back.
Mithral +1 Armor|AI: You get +1 to AC wearing it. This light, bendy metal lets mithral breastplates and chain shirts be worn under ordinary clothes. The mithral form drops any Dexterity (Stealth) disadvantage and any Strength requirement the base armor had.
Orb of Shielding (Irian Quartz)|ERLW: A polished crystal or stone sphere attuned with a plane of existence. Spellcasters can use it as a spellcasting focus. Holding it as you suffer radiant damage, you can react to cut the damage by 1d4, never below 0.
Orb of Shielding (Risian Shale)|ERLW: A polished crystal or stone sphere attuned with a plane of existence. Spellcasters can use it as a spellcasting focus. Holding it as you suffer cold damage, you can react to cut the damage by 1d4, never below 0.
Repeating Shot|EFA: Used for ranged attacks, this magic weapon gives +1 on attack and damage rolls and disregards the LD property when present. Without ammunition, the wielder's ranged attack roll produces a magic projectile that disappears right after hitting or missing.
Slumbering Dragon's Wrath Weapon|FTD: Dragon-themed decor covers this weapon, which absorbs breath energy from a hoard and deals that damage type. Scoring a natural 20 hits each creature you pick near the target (5 feet or less) for 5 damage of the breath weapon's type.
Stirring Dragon's Wrath Weapon|FTD: Dragon-themed decor covers this weapon, which absorbs breath energy from a hoard and deals that damage type. Scoring a natural 20 hits each creature you pick near the target (5 feet or less) for 5 damage of the breath weapon's type. You gain +1 on attack and damage rolls, and hits add 1d6 of that type.
Thayan Sword|AUD: Thayan knights of high rank often receive this sword after training. You gain +1 on attack and damage rolls with it. Knight of the Arcane: 4 charges, 1d4 returning at dawn, and holding it you can spend 1 to cast Searing Smite, Thunderous Smite, or Wrathful Smite (save DC 15). Resurgent Warrior: holding it, if you fall to 0 Hit Points without dying outright, you can stay at 1 instead, but not again before the next dawn.
Wakened Dragon's Wrath Weapon|FTD: Dragon decor covers it, and it absorbs hoard breath energy. Winged Ammunition|BMT: Ranged weapon attack rolls using this ammunition disregard half and Cover. Long range also carries no disadvantage on those attack rolls.
